maya (GTM): Quick standup for AuroraMarket co-listing. Need owners for benchmark, customer spotlight, inbound routing, and launch assets.
liam (Growth): Ill take the benchmark. Will produce a 1-page TL;DR + deep blog.
samir (PMM): Ill gather the customer quote and short case bullet points.
julia (Partner Ops): Ill confirm partner logo and press contact, plus embargo window.
noah (SalesOps): Routing: tag with utm_source=aurora&utm_campaign=aurora-listing-2026, route to aurora-sdr queue, SLA 24h.
zoe (Comms): Assets: long-form benchmark, short customer post, 3 social cards. Need hero stat by Thu.
liam (Growth): Hero stat candidate: "~30% lower unit cost across typical SaaS prompts."
samir (PMM): Demo: internal dry run Wed; partner-facing demo next Tue.
julia (Partner Ops): Sent invites for dry run Wed 9am PT.
legal-bot: Add quote + logo to review queue; standard 48h review.
maya (GTM): Owners recap: benchmark @liam, customer @samir+julia, routing @noah, comms @zoe, legal @legal-bot. Update the launch checklist when you pick up tasks. :rocket:
